capacity_evidence: P150 = one Blackhole chip with 32 GB: ~21 GB of weights (bfp4 MLP, bfp8 attention/LM head, bf16 embeddings) leave ~10 GB for KV cache (128 KiB/token in bfp8 across 64 layers), trace region and the single-chunk prefill activations; sliding-window layers do not support chunked prefill, so max_model_len must fit one prefill chunk. Multi-chip profiles shard weights and KV across chips and serve the full 65536.
notes: Values marked validated are updated by the bring-up pipeline (~/olmo3-bringup stages 04/05) before packaging; see doc/REPORT.md.
